provenControls: every material registered data class has explicit purpose, sensitivity, retention period and disposition
raw eligibility documents and secret credentials are forbidden from broad projections and operational logs
canonical payment and inventory/fulfillment evidence cannot be silently deleted by retention policy
privacy-sensitive exports require actor scope and an explicit purpose
member order reads are principal-bound to preview:member:001 and return only transaction/fulfillment/remedy fields
operator order reads require operator:orders.read bound to preview:operator:001
member notification reads are principal-bound to preview:member:001
route error logging records only error name/message rather than credentials or request payloads

deployedObservation.runtimeLogInspection: no bearer token, PREVIEW_API_AUTH_SECRET, provider secret or sensitive payload material observed in the inspected request logs
deployedObservation.limitation: successful authenticated deployed reads remain part of RC2-AUTH-001 runtime falsification and are not claimed here

closure.basis: The current RC2 candidate has an explicit executable data-class/retention/disposition registry, fail-closed minimization rules, actor-scoped privacy access controls, minimized read projections and exact-head conformance evidence. Remaining authenticated deployed-boundary work is tracked under RC2-AUTH-001 rather than RC2-PRIV-001.
